# Job 28 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 28 (28 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.13 — "its worth" vs. "its arrangement"
- **EMET:** "its-arrangement" (*erkah*) / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "its worth"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "its worth" — pricing context (vv.15-19) favors the "value" sense of *erekh*.

---

## V.22 — "Abaddon" vs. "Destruction"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "Abaddon" (transliteration) / **PNEUMA:** "Destruction"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Abaddon" — personified proper noun, parallel to "Death."

---

## V.28 — "the fear of the Lord" — unique use of *Adonai*
- **EMET/LOGOS:** note *Adonai* as unusual in Job / **PNEUMA:** no comment
- **SOPHIA ruling:** Translate as written; note the unique divine name usage without marking it as secondary.

---
*— SOPHIA*
